title: 证人
blurb_en: Through a café window, a deaf woman reads a man's lips as he plans a murder on the phone. Nobody believes her, and one word could mean two different places.
blurb_zh: 隔着咖啡店的玻璃，一个听不见的女人，从一个男人的嘴上看出他在电话里计划杀人。没有人相信她，而且有一个词，她看不准。
